screens_reviewed: Two scroll captures of app/(tabs)/index.tsx (Dashboard): top (03-home.png) showing header, Dashboard title, sync banner, offline-ready banner, 2x2 metric grid, and the dark 'Your assigned places' workflow card; and scrolled (04-home-assigned-places.png) showing the 'Assigned places' list of three place cards above the bottom tab bar.
verdict: A polished, legible dashboard with clear hierarchy, good spacing rhythm (YStack gap $6 / 28px section gap), and correct safe-area clearance under the Dynamic Island and home indicator. The main concern is design-system consistency: the screen hand-rolls MetricCard, ActionButton, EmptyStateCard, and the two status banners inline even though shared primitives for all of them exist in components/ui, and the local MetricCard uses a percentage+minWidth sizing scheme that can wrap awkwardly on narrow phones. No broken layout or off-platform behavior.

improvements.suggestion: Replace the local MetricCard with the shared components/ui/MetricCard.tsx. The shared tile uses flex={1} (clean equal columns), fontSize 24/lineHeight 28, and standard border tokens; the local copy diverges with width="48%", minWidth 160, fontSize 30, and a colored border per tone. design_system_components_used lists only ScaledParagraph/ScaledText, confirming the shared MetricCard primitive is bypassed here.

The grid uses width="48%" with style.minWidth: 160. On a ~390pt screen (content 360 after 2x15 padding) two 48% cards (~173pt) fit two-per-row as shown. On smaller phones (e.g. 320pt wide -> content ~290, 48% ~139 < 160 so minWidth wins) the two 160pt cards plus the $3 gap exceed the row and collapse to one-per-row, breaking the intended 2x2 grid. Prefer flex={1} on a fixed two-column XStack (or the shared MetricCard) instead of percentage+minWidth so the grid stays 2-up at all phone widths.
improvements.evidence: index.tsx:606-611 (width "48%", minWidth 160) with parent XStack gap="$3" flexWrap="wrap" at index.tsx:300; PHONE screenPaddingHorizontal=15 in responsive-layout-tokens.ts:795

improvements.location: app/(tabs)/index.tsx sync banner (211-253), offline-ready banner (255-298), ActionButton (656-690), EmptyStateCard (697-723)
improvements.suggestion: Several inline blocks duplicate shared primitives: the connectivity banner overlaps components/ui/StatusBanner.tsx, the empty list block overlaps components/ui/EmptyState.tsx, and the status pills overlap components/ui/Badge.tsx. Consolidating onto these reduces token drift (e.g. the inline banner re-derives surface/border colors that StatusBanner already centralizes).

The 'Places' metric passes tone="blue", but getMetricTone (lib/design-system.ts:528-542) only handles green/purple/orange and otherwise returns the primary tone, so 'Places/4' renders in dark primary green rather than a distinct blue. Either add a blue branch to getMetricTone (info/sky tokens exist) or drop the unused tone value so the four tiles read as intentionally colored.
improvements.evidence: index.tsx:301 vs core.md lib/design-system.ts:528-542 (no "blue" case); screenshot 03-home.png shows PLACES/4 in dark green like the default tone

improvements.suggestion: bottomPadding is a hard-coded 132 rather than derived from the dynamic tab-bar height (getResponsiveTabBarLayout) plus insets.bottom. It clears the tab bar in both screenshots, but on devices with a taller home-indicator inset or on tablet (taller buttonHeight) the gap can drift. Consider computing bottom padding from tabBarLayout.height + a fixed margin.
improvements.evidence: index.tsx:117; getResponsiveTabBarLayout in responsive-layout.ts:703-718 already computes height from buttonHeight + insets

tamagui_notes: ScaledText/ScaledParagraph are used consistently for all text (imported aliased as Text/Paragraph at index.tsx:25), so numeric fontSize values respect the auditor's font-scale preference (ScaledText.tsx:2295). Good.

The screen reads colors via the useDesignSystem() hook (index.tsx:39) rather than Tamagui theme tokens; values like rgba(255,255,255,0.78) on the dark workflow card (index.tsx:322) and borderColor rgba(71,203,175,0.18) (index.tsx:314) are raw literals not tied to a palette token, so they will not shift with theme.

Heading sizes are inline numeric literals (Dashboard fontSize 34 at index.tsx:197, workflow card 26 at index.tsx:333, section 21 at index.tsx:391) rather than Tamagui font-size tokens; intentional for this design but means typography scale lives in the screen, not the config.
platform_notes: Safe-area top: index.tsx ScrollView relies on contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior="automatic" (line 113) plus the root Stack contentStyle paddingTop:20 (_layout.tsx:1378); it does not pass topInset to getResponsiveContentContainerStyle. In 03-home.png the avatar/Dashboard header clears the Dynamic Island with comfortable margin, so top inset is handled.

Bottom safe area: tab bar paddingBottom adds insets.bottom via getResponsiveTabBarLayout (responsive-layout.ts:710), and the home-indicator area is respected under the HOME/PLACES/EXECUTE/REPORTS bar in both shots.

Thumb reach: primary CTAs are spread vertically (workflow-card actions mid-screen, per-place Start/Continue/View report buttons in the list); all are reachable. The header refresh/settings buttons are 42x42 (index.tsx:157-189) — above the 44pt guideline only by 2pt, acceptable but at the small end for top-corner targets.
not_assessable: Exact WCAG contrast ratios (e.g. violet 'DRAFTS 0' numeral on white surface, mutedForeground body on surface) are estimated from tokens, not measured; none appeared clearly below AA in the light theme screenshots.
Loading and error runtime states (Spinner at index.tsx:396, errorMessage block at 245, Alert on incomplete offline setup at 537) are not shown in these captures.
Behavior at narrow phone widths (<360pt) for the metric grid wrap is inferred from the sizing math, not observed; the screenshots are at standard width.
Offline / empty-list appearance (EmptyStateCard, WifiOff banner) not captured.
score_rationale: Solid, ships-with-minor-polish. Hierarchy, spacing, typography, and iPhone safe-area handling are all correct and the screen is fully on-platform with no broken layout. Points come off for design-system consistency (inline MetricCard/ActionButton/EmptyState/banners duplicating existing shared primitives), a percentage+minWidth metric grid that can wrap on narrow phones, an unused tone="blue" that silently falls back to primary, and a hard-coded bottom padding — all real but non-blocking.
